_about: Model weights the engine can run locally. NONE of them is stored in this repo: each is downloaded on the user's machine (scripts/depth_map.py --fetch) into PHANTASIC_MODELS (default ~/.cache/phantasic/models) and checked against sha256 before use.

depth-anything-v2-small.paper: Depth Anything V2, Yang et al. 2024, arXiv:2406.09414
depth-anything-v2-small.input: pixel_values float32 [1,3,H,W], RGB, /255, mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], std [0.229,0.224,0.225], H and W multiples of 14
depth-anything-v2-small.output: predicted_depth float32 [1,H,W], relative inverse depth (larger = nearer)
